issues.explanation: $name and $renameName hold free-text user input but have no #[Validate] rule and actions never call $this->validate(); validation relies solely on domain-action ValidationException surfaced via addError.

Create and rename forms add errors to the bag (assertHasErrors passes) but render no @error block for name/renameName, unlike serve.blade.php which renders @error('mode'); users may not see the domain error.

Write actions create/rename/toggleActive/setAccess resolve scoped models but do not call $this->authorize, relying on CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess to deny; safe per forbidden tests but deviates from Livewire Rule 3 defense-in-depth.
waitingTickets uses CallMode::tryFrom(mode) inside when(); a tampered bogus mode yields null and returns the unfiltered list instead of empty, though callNext still rejects it.

conventions.evidence: Uses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket, Gate/policy checks, x-label/x-input, Bulma box/modal, CHANGELOG and business-rules sync; deviation: Queues.php:88,104 $name/$renameName lack #[Validate] (cf Serve.php:367 mode) and create/rename/toggle lack explicit $this->authorize

readability.evidence: Small focused methods openCreate/closeCreate/create/openQueue/rename/toggleActive/openAccess/setAccess, comments marking untrusted client state, sibling Bulma button/modal style in queues.blade.php:728-739,769-811

requirements.evidence: Queues.php:136-144 create w/ derived slug+reset; :182-189 rename w/ Str::slug; :196-217 confirmToggle/toggleActive w/ confirmation modal; :249-252 scoped findOrFail; Serve.php:393-429 callNext null/Inactive/NoWaiting/rate-limit; queues.blade.php:728-730 row button only openQueue, :856-872 toggle modal no wire:confirm; lang/en/ui.php:539-580 required keys present

scope.evidence: Diff touches only Queues/Serve/members-tabs/navbar/routes/lang/docs/tests; extra keys (queues_empty, serve_rate_limited) support required UI; no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: Scoped $entity->queues()->findOrFail() and memberships()->findOrFail() in Queues.php:149,165,182,198,212,221,249-250 and Serve.php:401; Gate::denies create guard Queues.php:289; #[Locked] entity/lastCalledTicketId Serve.php:358,370; RateLimiter 10/min Serve.php:407,426; all output via {{ }}; remaining gap is missing explicit $this->authorize (guarded in actions)

simplicity.evidence: Queues.php:270-283 surfaceDomainErrors reuses ValidationException; no service layers; reuses existing x-label/x-input and CallMode/policies; minimum code for required modals

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Entity/QueuesTest.php ~20 tests incl foreign/tampered editingQueueId/accessQueueId nondisclosure and every-action-forbidden-after-demotion; ServeTest.php foreign/uncallable/tampered-mode/locked-property/rate-limit; MembersTest tablist/tabs; LocalizationTest key parity; NavbarRenderTest

review.summary: Adds Queues management and Serve call-next panels plus members tabs, navbar links, translations, docs and thorough Pest coverage. Requirements, security properties and scope are met via scoped resolution and domain actions; nits are missing #[Validate]/@error on queue name fields and reliance on action-level auth instead of explicit component authorize.
